claim: Canonical global invariant negation and exact Boolean character action on the four actual global intrinsic differential pullbacks
author: /root/restart_hodge_gluing
index_scope: All four fixed published targets i:Fin4 and every Boolean source sign b:Fin4 -> Bool. Generic Weierstrass negation retains the explicit domain/discriminant/nonzero2y hypotheses, all discharged in the actual application.
external_input_scope: No new literature input. The pinned Mathlib integral-scheme restriction theorem and universal-differential/module-sheaf APIs are consumed with exact stated hypotheses.

obligations.name: Source hypotheses
obligations.required: A genuine free intrinsic Omega frame on an integral completion, actual negation maps, and canonical pullback functoriality.
obligations.constructed: The actual IntrinsicGlobalFrame318.frame and CompletedIntegral318.completed_integral supply the frame and integrality. GluedNegation318 supplies the whole involution and affine square. IntrinsicDifferentialFunctor318 proves canonical composition from universal derivation uniqueness.
obligations.why_match: No generic-to-global principle or differential action is assumed. The structure-sheaf restriction theorem transfers through the actual frame. The negative scalar equation is proved using the actual affine coordinate involution.

obligations.name: Constructed objects
obligations.required: The existing completed published elliptic curves, actual contact normalization and actual globally pulled differential sections.
obligations.constructed: The endpoints retain the literal completed Scheme maps, the specified invariant dx/(2y), ContactGlobalSigns318.map units b, and ContactCharacterDifferentials318.differential i.
obligations.why_match: No abstract character representation, rational proxy form, replacement involution or isomorphic curve is substituted.

obligations.name: Domain and index coverage
obligations.required: The entire completed models, all four published targets and all sixteen Boolean source signs.
obligations.constructed: The target equality is proved for global sections by restriction to the entire nonempty finite chart. Every i:Fin 4 and b:Fin 4 -> Bool is quantified.
obligations.why_match: Finite branch points are retained in the affine equation and cancellation, and the global restriction theorem proves equality on the whole completion. There is no sample-point or dense-generic-only conclusion.

obligations.name: Transition and comparison maps
obligations.required: Relate actual algebraic affine pullback to canonical intrinsic pullback and actual source-sign commuting squares.
obligations.constructed: IntrinsicDifferentialSectionPullback318.sectionMap_naturality compares the full affine negation square; globalSection_restrict compares actual global restrictions. The fixed CharacterBooleanGlobal318 positive/negative equalities are consumed through globalSection_congr and globalSection_comp.
obligations.why_match: The actual contravariant pullback order is preserved. No equality of field maps is used in place of a Scheme-map square.

obligations.name: Identity of the consumed object
obligations.required: The negated generator must be the invariant whose actual completed-character pullback defines each source differential.
obligations.constructed: PublishedInvariantNegation318 names ContactCharacterDifferentials318.invariant i; the next theorem unfolds the existing definition of differential i and composes its same pullback.
obligations.why_match: The final equality is in global sections of ContactIntrinsicDifferentials318.omega units, not in a detached character eigenspace.

obligations.name: Coefficient and normalization conventions
obligations.required: Retain the target normalization dx/(2y), literal negation and exact rational epsilon with scalar one.
obligations.constructed: Actual affine negation fixes x and sends y to -y. The whole-affine denominator-free equation 2y*omega=dx yields pullback(omega)=-omega. Epsilon is the actual complementary triple-root sign. Constants are from the actual source Q-structure.
obligations.why_match: No unspecified proportionality factor or reciprocal scale is introduced. Positive signs give identity and negative signs give exact additive negation. The earlier published coordinate scale is already built into differential i and is not changed.

obligations.name: Local conditions
obligations.required: Justify cancellation and extension of equality on the actual integral schemes.
obligations.constructed: A module sheaf with an explicit isomorphism to the unit sheaf inherits scalar cancellation and injective restriction on nonempty integral opens. These are applied using the actual global Omega frame and genuine nonempty finite chart.
obligations.why_match: No local frame is promoted to a global trivialization. The global frame and integrality were separately proved, and the exact structure-sheaf restriction theorem supplies the needed detection.

obligations.name: Exceptional cases
obligations.required: Discharge nonzero2y on all actual published targets; retain generic hypotheses honestly.
obligations.constructed: The generic negation theorem explicitly assumes a domain base, discriminant unit and nonzero2y. Each fixed Q target discharges these: discriminantUnit is established, y is nonzero by the original rawY embedding, and two is nonzero in characteristic zero.
obligations.why_match: Cancellation never divides by a function at its zero points. It uses torsion-free rank-one sections on an integral open; the original denominator-free relation includes all finite points.

obligations.name: Downstream consumption
obligations.required: Supply actual global differential character equivariance for the elliptic quotient correspondence.
obligations.constructed: The canonical pullback action of every whole-source sign on each of the four actual independent global forms is exactly its complementary character.
obligations.why_match: This does not prove the four forms exhaust global Omega, create a source Picard/Jacobian object, identify a Jacobian isogeny or polarization, or establish PEL/KS. Root signs are not relabeled inertia.

not_claimed: basis or dimension of all global differentials
new fifth full-root quotient or differential
validation: All six source bodies passed bounded strict checks. Fresh target-only recursive endpoint/axiom audit passed 28 declarations across six modules, standard roots only. Hosted integration and non-author application review are separate.
